script:
tmp=$(mktemp) || exit $?
trap 'rm -f -- "$tmp" "$tmp.sorted"' 0
find /mnt/media_rw/emulated/DCIM -type f -print0 > "$tmp" || exit $?
after=''
seen_after=1
if [ -n "$after" ]; then
    seen_after=0
    printf '%s\000' "$after" >> "$tmp" || exit $?
fi
LC_ALL=C sort -z -- "$tmp" > "$tmp.sorted" || exit $?
printf '\000' >> "$tmp.sorted" || exit $?
printf 'CAMCTL-DIRECTORY/1\000' || exit $?
count=0
while :; do
    IFS= read -r -d '' path || exit $?
    if [ -z "$path" ]; then
        [ "$seen_after" -eq 1 ] || exit 1
        printf 'END\000' || exit $?
        break
    fi
    if [ "$path" = "$after" ]; then
        seen_after=1
        continue
    fi
    [ "$seen_after" -eq 1 ] || continue
    if [ "$count" -ge 128 ]; then
        printf 'MORE\000' || exit $?
        break
    fi
    printf '%s\000' "$path" || exit $?
    count=$((count + 1))
done < "$tmp.sorted"

sh -c 'target=/mnt/media_rw/emulated/DCIM/OSMO_0001/VID_0001.OSV
parent=/mnt/media_rw/emulated/DCIM/OSMO_0001
scan_root=/mnt/media_rw/emulated/DCIM/OSMO_0001/
rm_status=-
rm -- "$target"
rm_status=$?
(
    scan_status=1
    if [ -d "$parent" ] && [ -r "$parent" ] && [ -x "$parent" ]; then
        find "$scan_root" -print0
        scan_status=$?
    fi
    printf '"'"'\000%s\000'"'"' "$scan_status"
) | (
    state=0
    count=0
    roots=0
    invalid=0
    while :; do
        IFS= read -r -d '"'"''"'"' entry || exit 1
        [ -n "$entry" ] || break
        if [ "$entry" = "$parent" ] || [ "$entry" = "$scan_root" ]; then
            roots=$((roots + 1))
            continue
        fi
        case "$entry" in
            "$scan_root"*) relative=${entry#"$scan_root"};;
            *) invalid=1; continue;;
        esac
        case "/$relative/" in *"/../"*|*"/./"*|*"//"*) invalid=1; continue;; esac
        [ "$entry" = "$target" ] || continue
        count=$((count + 1))
        if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then
            state=duplicate
        elif [ -f "$target" ]; then
            state=1
        else
            state=type
        fi
    done
    IFS= read -r -d '"'"''"'"' scan_status || exit 1
    case "$scan_status" in ""|*[!0-9]*) exit 1;; esac
    IFS= read -r -d '"'"''"'"' extra && exit 1
    [ -z "$extra" ] || exit 1
    if [ "$scan_status" -ne 0 ] && [ "$state" = 0 ]; then state=unknown; fi
    if [ "$roots" -gt 1 ] || [ "$invalid" -eq 1 ] ||
        { [ "$scan_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$roots" -ne 1 ]; }; then state=invalid; fi
    printf '"'"'CAMCTL-FILE/1\000%s\000%s\000%s\000%s\000%s\000END\000'"'"' delete "$target" "$state" "$rm_status" "$scan_status" || exit $?
    [ "$scan_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$state" != type ] && [ "$state" != duplicate ] && [ "$state" != invalid ]
)'
